reference.title: Torii of Nishiki tenmangu by Hidehiro Komatsu at the east end of Nishiki Ichiba
reference.author: Hidehiro Komatsu
reference.associationBasis: The retained description identifies the torii between Teramachi and Shinkyogoku at Nishiki Market's eastern end; this matches the named mapped gate. The original image was inspected at its full resolution on this review date.

observed: White folded zigzag streamers hang from a tan braided rope below the central plaque.
The streamers show shaded folds and an unlit diffuse appearance in this daylight reference.
The central plaque has a dark field, gold-colored border and vertically arranged lettering.
